name: OK
description: Standard response for successful HTTP requests

name: Created
description: Request fulfilled resulting in creation of a new resource

name: Accepted
description: Request accepted for processing but processing incomplete

name: Bad Request
description: Server cannot process request due to perceived client error

name: Unauthorized
description: Authentication is required and has failed or not been provided

name: Forbidden
description: Server understands request but refuses to authorize it

name: Not Found
description: Requested resource could not be found on the server

name: Too Many Requests
description: User has sent too many requests in a given amount of time (Rate Limited)

name: Internal Server Error
description: Generic error message when an unexpected condition occurred

name: Bad Gateway
description: Server acting as a gateway received an invalid response from upstream

name: Service Unavailable
description: Server cannot handle request due to overload or maintenance

name: Gateway Timeout
description: Gateway did not receive a timely response from upstream server
